title: unique_roots does not clear stale test dirs; pid reuse can resurrect state
description: Found by robustness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml. announce_store.rs:347-357: unique_roots builds temp paths from a per-process counter plus pid but never clears pre-existing directories; a crashed prior run whose pid was reused can leave pre-populated records that spuriously fail tests like store_survives_restart_and_enforces_durable_floor (flaky failure, not a false pass). Panic-leaked dirs share the same root cause. Fix: remove_dir_all before create_dir_all in unique_roots, or add a random component to the path.
